title: ECIL Graduates / Diploma Apprentices Recruitment 2026
summary: Electronic Corporation of India Limited (ECIL) , has released a Notification for the recruitment of Graduates / Diploma Apprentices Posts on its official website. This recruitment is being conducted for 242 vacancies. The ECIL Application Form has started on 24 November 2026 & the candidates can apply until 13 December 2026 . The Minimum age required is N/A & The Maximum Age Is 25 Years as on 31 December 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for ECIL Graduates / Diploma Apprentices Recruitment 2026 which are given below. ( Advt No : 12/2026 )
qualification: Candidates must have BE / B.Tech Course in Related Trade / Branches from any recognized University. 3 Years Engineering Diploma.
